<h1 align="center">rc-compress {{version}}</h1>

> **Test version.** rc-compress is in development; installed copies update themselves from the app
> (Settings → About → Check for updates).

| Your system | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `rc-compress_{{version}}_x64.exe` |
| Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) | `rc-compress_{{version}}_aarch64.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel | `rc-compress_{{version}}_x64.dmg` |
| Linux (Ubuntu, Debian) | `rc-compress_{{version}}_amd64.deb` |
| Linux (any) | `rc-compress_{{version}}_amd64.AppImage` |

You don't need `latest.json`, the `.sig` or `.tar.gz` files, or the source code: the app's updater uses them.

The downloads aren't signed yet: Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" (More info → Run anyway), and macOS may
say the app is damaged or from an unidentified developer (right-click → Open).

Based on [compressO](https://github.com/codeforreal1/compressO) by Code For Real.
